requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: For the OfficeJet Pro 9010 series, reduce the number of product reference names presented to the customer on 123.hp.com to a single, consistent name to avoid user confusion and errors.

requirements.Requirement: Printer able to run all new/current EM / market segment media
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer must reliably print on all new and current EM (Evaluation Media) and market segment media, meeting intervention specifications for different media and climatic conditions for the Manhattan platform.

requirements.Requirement: Product can be placed and work on uneven surface ( sofa , table cloth , carpet …)
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer must function correctly without hardware failure when placed on uneven surfaces such as sofas, table cloths, or carpets, specifically ensuring the input tray sensor flag does not break.

requirements.Requirement: Tilt left and right each while printing
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: Assess whether the printer experiences any functional failure if tilted 20 degrees left or right during printing.

requirements.Requirement: Put printer on trolley and print
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer must be able to print on a trolley without any print quality issues.
